originalSourceText:
9. Why is StandardScaler included in the scikit-learn Pipeline prior
   to feeding input data to MLPRegressor for Inverse Dynamics?

  A) To convert 2D array inputs into 3D image tensors.

   B) To normalize all input features to zero mean and unit variance.

   C) To force all output joint torques to remain non-negative.

  D) To eliminate duplicate rows from the generated dataset.

   Answer: B
   Lecture 55: Implementation of AI to Robot Dynamics 16
